title: Hotel: Cancellation, Waitlist, and Pricing Rules
description: Add cancellation policies, waitlist, seasonal pricing, and room upgrades.

data.text: Extend the hotel system to support free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in, a waitlist for fully booked dates, and dynamic pricing for peak seasons.

data.title: CancellationPolicy and Waitlist
Why ICancellationPolicy?
data.text: Cancellation rules vary by hotel, season, and booking channel. An interface lets you swap policies at runtime without changing Reservation or Hotel code.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: CancellationPolicy is a strategy that keeps Hotel agnostic
Waitlist is a FIFO queue keyed by room type and date range
Promote from waitlist when a matching room opens up
Cancellation frees the room and triggers waitlist promotion
data.takeaway: Cancellation and waitlist turn a static booking system into a dynamic marketplace. Decouple policies with interfaces so rules evolve independently.
